stem: Which sentence best describes a difference between Ricochet and Confetti?

options.label: A
options.text: Ricochet required training, but Confetti did not.

options.label: B
options.text: Ricochet helps many people, but Confetti helps one person.

options.label: C
options.text: Ricochet spends time outdoors, but Confetti works indoors.

options.label: D
options.text: Ricochet does not notice other animals, but Confetti does.
